create_von_mises_distribution: create a VonMises distribution with a given loc and concentration parameter for circular data
sample_von_mises: sample from a VonMises distribution with differentiable gradients through the sampling process
evaluate_log_prob_von_mises: evaluate the log probability of values under a VonMises circular distribution
compute_cdf_von_mises: compute the cumulative distribution function and survival function of a VonMises distribution
compute_kl_divergence_von_mises: compute the KL divergence or cross entropy between two VonMises distributions
